name: AWS Manager
description: Admin UI to store per-user AWS credentials and manage S3 buckets/files and AWS Organization accounts via the AWS PHP SDK.
package: AWS Custom Org Account and s3 client Bucket
project_description: AWS Manager adds a Drupal admin section (Configuration → AWS Manager) for connecting a Drupal site to Amazon Web Services through the official aws/aws-sdk-php library. Each Drupal user saves their own AWS Access Key ID and Secret Access Key, which the module persists in custom database tables (created by hook_schema) rather than as configuration. Using those credentials it drives three AWS services from Drupal forms: S3 (list buckets, create/delete buckets, list/upload/replace/delete objects, presigned download URLs, with files grouped into Images/Documents/Others tabs and metadata tracked in an aws_files table), AWS Organizations (list, view, create and remove/leave member accounts via OrganizationsClient), and STS (getCallerIdentity to decide leaveOrganization vs removeAccountFromOrganization on delete). All routes live under /admin/aws/* and are gated by a single restricted permission, 'access aws manager'. The module ships no config entities, no plugins and no Drush commands; it is entirely a set of FormBase/ConfirmFormBase forms plus a small CSS/JS (aws_ui) library for the AJAX-modal UI. Region is hard-coded to us-east-1 for the AWS clients (the file browser re-resolves the region from an AuthorizationHeaderMalformed error). A single alter hook, hook_aws_manager_upload_file_alter(), is documented for adjusting upload metadata.
